# ChipLab — ITCH-50 silicon lab
> Local-first WebAssembly + WebGPU lab for a NASDAQ ITCH 5.0 parser, with RTL, formal proofs, Node backend, MCP, npm/PyPI packages, single EXE, Docker and Vercel.

## Core summary
- Version: **0.3.0 "Local Cloud"** (stable; 1.0.0 is not claimed).
- RTL: SystemVerilog, all 22 ITCH 5.0 opcodes, tkeep/tlast, 64-bit shares, 128/256/512-bit datapaths.
- Honest latency: 2 clocks from s_axis_tdata to registered output at the 322.26 MHz model clock; 1 clock from the window register.
- Verified: 1,000,000-record full-field regression, 0 mismatches; Z3 + CVC5 formal PASS.
- WASM: 50 KB Rust core used by browser, Node, MCP, npm, PyPI and the single EXE.
- WebGPU: compute bins + render, Canvas2D fallback, OPFS persistence, PWA/offline.
- Native: wgpu Vulkan/DX12 compute runner (AMD Radeon 680M, 200k records in 7.85 ms).
- Local cloud: LAN service, local JSON store under `.data/`, optional bearer token, web Test/Sync/Pull panel.
- Interfaces: Node `/api/*`, MCP stdio (12 read-only tools), npm `@chiplab/core`, PyPI `chiplab-itch`.
- Distribution: `dist/chiplab.exe`, Docker, Vercel static + stateless API, tag-driven GitHub release with SBOM + SHA-256.

## Quick start
```bash
node backend/server.mjs          # http://127.0.0.1:4173
node backend/server.mjs --host 0.0.0.0 --token "long-token"   # local cloud over LAN
node backend/run.mjs --compare --count 1000000
node mcp/server.mjs
npm run build:exe
docker build -t chiplab:0.3.0 .
```

## Honest limits
- Pre-silicon; no tapeout, no Fmax sign-off.
- Multi-frame MoldUDP64 back-to-back flow control is experimental.
- The feed is synthetic and seeded.
- WebGPU uses f32 only for bar heights; parsing is integer-exact.
